knownGaps: strict mode skips unknown/nonpositive cost estimates (no reservation) — admission must deny these explicitly
input/output estimator omits cache-creation surcharges; ordinary-input estimates are not a worst-case billing bound
defaults can fail open on reservation-write failure or reduce a reservation to remaining headroom while allowing the request
counters are cached/TTL-bound; no-Redis synchronization is in-process only; outstanding reservations are not a durable per-request ledger
cancellation settles estimated input and releases output; missing actual_cost reconciles as zero; failure cleanup may release to zero
global litellm.max_budget is a cached aggregate read check, not an atomic reservation scope
budgetReservation.authoritativeCeiling: safe integer 10000000 microUSD (application reference), one non-resetting qualification team max_budget=10 covering every task/attempt key
